title: 第3章 你守护我三天我守护你一世第4章 韩家门风只看人品
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
嗯？
这突如其来的一幕，让在场之人，都是一怔，所有人的目光，纷纷看向韩清雪的身后，最终落在了楚天铭的身上。
韩鑫惊讶至极的看着楚天铭：“死瞎子你能看见？”
“我看你m个头！”
楚天铭懒得废话，直接一巴掌反抽了回去。
啪的一声。
韩鑫没有闪开，被打的原地转了一圈，右脸被抽懒得红肿起来。
“死瞎子，草你姥姥，我今天非得把你废了！”
身为韩家天骄，韩家大长老的孙子，韩鑫何时被人打过，何况对方还是个死瞎子，当即暴怒，二话不说，抬起另外一只手掌，便向着楚天铭的面门拍去。
韩清雪脸色大变：“天铭，快闪开。”
韩鑫这一掌，势如雷霆，出招极快，然而此刻，他的动作在楚天铭的眼睛里，却好似被放慢了一百倍，犹如蜗牛爬行，缓慢无比。
“滚！”
楚天铭神色一动，侧身躲闪，轻而易举的避开了韩鑫的掌刀，与此同时右脚闪电般踢出，不偏不倚，正好踹在了韩鑫的胸口。
砰！
韩鑫倒飞了出去，重重的摔在了地上，然后在地上，连滚了十几圈，才停了下来。
靠？
什么情况？
这瞎子不仅避开了韩鑫的霹雳掌，还一脚将韩鑫打飞出去？
这不是开玩笑吧！
看到这一幕，所有人都是怔在原地，一脸懵逼的表情。

就在众人错愕的时候，韩鑫从地上爬起，表情十分痛苦，看起来楚天铭这一拳，将他伤的不轻。
“死瞎子……你的力量怎么会这么强，你不是无法修炼么？”
“呵呵，你想知道么？跪地上给清雪磕三个响头，然后大声喊韩清雪，是天河城最美的女子，我就告诉你如何！”
楚天铭似笑非笑的说道。
听到这话，韩清雪在一旁哭笑不得，这家伙还有心思在这里说笑？
“你一个死瞎子，有什么资格让小爷道歉，今天小爷非得打死你不可！”
韩鑫恼羞成怒，身为韩家直系弟子，被一个瞎子这般羞辱，岂能忍受，当即向着其他韩家弟子命令道：“兄弟们一起上，干死这个家伙！
出了事情，小爷负责！”
十几个韩家弟子立刻蜂拥而上，向着楚天铭围攻而来。
韩清雪想要拦阻，可是没有修为的她，只能站在旁边大喊着住手，可是根本没有人理会。
楚天铭见此，并不慌乱，眼瞳内的金色光轮，缓缓转动，那些韩家弟子的攻击路线，尽数被他捕捉。
他脚步快速移动，轻而易举的便避开那些韩家弟子的攻击，同时双拳紧握，连续击出。
砰砰砰！
不到一盏茶的功夫，那十几个韩家弟子便全部趴在地上，哀嚎不起。
“靠……什么情况！
？”
韩鑫彻底傻眼，做梦也没有想到楚天铭竟然一口气干倒了十几个韩家弟子。
要知道，这些韩家弟子，虽然都是肉身境的武者，可是这么多人一起出手，连真气境的弟子，都不可能抗衡！
楚天铭却毫发无损的就将这些韩家弟子打翻在地！
这家伙还是人？

“该你了！”
content_en:
Um?
This sudden scene made everyone present stunned. Everyone's eyes looked behind Han Qingxue, and finally fell on Chu Tianming.
Han Xin looked at Chu Tianming in great surprise: "You blind man, can you see?"
"I see how big you are!"
Chu Tianming was too lazy to talk nonsense and slapped him back.
There was a snap.
Han Xin did not move away. He was beaten and spun around in a circle. The right side of his face was red and swollen from the slap.
"You blind man, I'm going to kill your grandma today!"
As the pride of the Han family and the grandson of the eldest elder of the Han family, Han Xin had never been beaten before, not to mention that the other person was blind. He immediately became furious and without saying a word, he raised his other palm and slapped Chu Tianming in the face.
Han Qingxue's expression changed drastically: "Tian Ming, get out of the way."
Han Xin's palm was as powerful as thunder and moved extremely fast. However, at this moment, in Chu Tianming's eyes, his movements seemed to be slowed down a hundred times, like a snail crawling, extremely slow.
"Get out!"
Chu Tianming's expression changed, and he dodged sideways, easily avoiding Han Xin's palm knife. At the same time, he kicked out his right foot like lightning, and hit Han Xin's chest impartially.
Bang!
Han Xin flew out, fell heavily to the ground, and then rolled on the ground for more than ten times before stopping.
Depend on?
What's going on?
This blind man not only avoided Han Xin's thunderbolt palm, but also knocked Han Xin away with his kick?
This is no joke!
Seeing this scene, everyone was stunned in place, with confused expressions on their faces.
Just when everyone was stunned, Han Xin got up from the ground with a very painful expression. It seemed that Chu Tianming's punch had seriously injured him.
"Damn blind man...how can your power be so strong? Aren't you unable to practice?"
"Haha, do you want to know? Kneel down and kowtow to Qingxue three times, and then shout loudly that Han Qingxue is the most beautiful woman in Tianhe City. I will tell you how!"
Chu Tianming said with a half-smile.
Hearing this, Han Qingxue couldn't laugh or cry at the side. Does this guy still have the intention to joke here?
"You are a blind man, what qualifications do you have to ask me to apologize? Today I have to beat you to death!"
Han Xin became angry with shame. As a direct disciple of the Han family, how could he bear being humiliated by a blind man? He immediately ordered to other Han family disciples: "Brothers, come together and kill this guy!
If something happens, I will be responsible! "
More than a dozen Han family disciples immediately swarmed up and besieged Chu Tianming.
Han Qingxue wanted to stop her, but without cultivation, she could only stand aside and yell to stop, but no one paid any attention to her.
Seeing this, Chu Tianming did not panic. The golden halo in his eyes slowly rotated, and he captured all the attack routes of the Han family disciples.
He moved quickly and easily avoided the attacks of the Han family disciples. At the same time, he clenched his fists and struck out continuously.
Bang bang bang!
In less than a cup of tea, the dozen Han family disciples were all lying on the ground, wailing.
"Damn...what's going on!
? "
Han Xin was completely dumbfounded. He never dreamed that Chu Tianming would kill more than a dozen Han family disciples in one go.
You know, although these disciples of the Han family are all warriors in the physical realm, with so many people attacking together, it is impossible for even the disciples in the true energy realm to compete!
Chu Tianming knocked these Han family disciples to the ground without any damage!
Is this guy still a human?
"It's your turn!"
